title: Earth imagery credits for orbital preview
credit: NASA/GSFC, Blue Marble; Reto Stockli and NASA Earth Observatory. City lights: Craig Mayhew and Robert Simmon, NASA GSFC; data courtesy Marc Imhoff (NASA GSFC) and Christopher Elvidge (NOAA NGDC).
context: Historical satellite-observation composites, not a live Earth view. Artistic scene scale and lighting. No NASA endorsement.
rendering_changes: Shader saturation adjustment, separate cloud blend, scene-Sun lighting and thin atmospheric limb. Each source map wraps exactly once. Night side adds the city-lights map, gated by the solar terminator; ocean sun glint is derived from the surface map's blue dominance.

files.processing: Resampled to 4096 x 2048 and encoded as JPEG quality 90 with macOS sips. No geographic edits.
Resampled to 4096 x 2048 and encoded as JPEG quality 90 with macOS sips. No cloud-pattern edits.
Converted to greyscale, resampled to 2048 x 1024 (Lanczos), JPEG quality 88 with Pillow. Mobile variant 1024 x 512, quality 85. No geographic edits.

runtime_selection: The starfield-first scene loads the 2048px Earth maps on all viewport sizes. 4096px files are retained source variants and are not requested by this scene.
sky_background: Art-directed procedural fixed stars and faint galactic dust band, generated in star-field.js. Not a photographic image or astronomical catalogue.
